prompt: Record a 3-second voice-over from the microphone (no screen recording) into the Splice project {project}, placed where the screen take starts, then lower its volume to 80%. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: voice-over on an audio lane
checks.expr: any(l['kind'] == 'audio' for l in lanes) and any(i['kind'] == 'sound' for i in items)

checks.name: about 3 seconds
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and 60 <= i['length'] <= 110 for i in items)

checks.name: volume 80%
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and abs(i['params'].get('volume', 1) - 0.8) < 0.05 for i in items)
